answer: Coordination toll beacon. Agents broadcast a signed beacon per decision round; peers only honor messages whose beacon maps to a verified prior wander through a shared random walk, proving sequential presence rather than parallel identities. Nectar accrues only to beacons that survive cross-peer corroboration. Each extra identity must repeat the full walk and sustain distinct corroboration, costing roughly one walk's compute and latency per sybil, so coordinating N identities scales linearly in real work.
